ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:1 ratio of high-intensity white/cream central pixels to low-intensity black perimeter pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupying the central 70% of both lobes. Left lobe features a unique cluster of three circular dark spots and a single curved dark line in the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch at the central convergence point of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serrations along the superior boundary, with higher pixel-amplitude peaks observed on the outer lateral sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering into sharp, well-defined lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of white, circular, high-contrast pixel groups concentrated on the lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with epibiont attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent dark linear markings on the left lobe: one horizontal arcuate mark and one diagonal linear mark positioned towards the lower margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The presence of a localized pattern of four dark pigmentation marks on the left lobe that form a distinct visual configuration.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique spatial arrangement of three dark dots and one curved line on the left lobe ventral surface mimicking a human facial 'smiley' pattern.
